ticket.subject: Invite link expired
ticket.body_text:
Hi team,

We invited a new colleague yesterday, but the invite link says it has expired when they open it.

We have free seats on our plan, so that should not be the problem.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Please help us get them into the workspace.

Thanks,
Dana Brandt
IT lead, Amberlow AB
